newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk Demirbank to triple its capital.
newsitem.headline: Turk Demirbank to triple its capital.

text.p: Turkey's medium-sized commercial Demirbank decided to increase its capital to 16.5 trillion lira from current 5.5 trillion lira, the Istanbul Stock Exchange reported.

The bank plans to issue 9.09 trillion lira of rights, or 1.653-for-one existing share, and 1.91 trillion lira of bonuses, or 0.347-for-one existing share after securing approval from Turkey's Capital Markets Board (SPK).
Demirbank whose shares are also listed on the Munich bourse, initiated a Level 1 ADR programme on U.S. bourses late last year. It also seeks listing of the ADRs on the Frankfurt bourse.
